output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The 'transfer' function does not check whether the _to address is 0x0, allowing a transfer to a 0x0 address and causing a denial of service.
The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows a user to cause a denial of service (loss of tokens) to any target user.
The 'setPrices' function uses 'msg.value' as a buy price, allowing any user to set the buy price to any value, potentially causing a denial of service.
The 'buy' function allows any user to set the buy price to any value, potentially causing a denial of service.
